title: The ruff cache in build/ instead of the root
author: Claude-JG
description: A ruff run of the editor or by hand wrote .ruff_cache into the repository root. cache-dir in [tool.ruff] puts it into build/.ruff_cache; exudev clean removes it there, and still a .ruff_cache in the root left by older runs.
releaseNotes: The ruff cache is written into build/.ruff_cache instead of the repository root (cache-dir in pyproject.toml); exudev clean removes it.
